subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Regression Analysis
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Regression Analysis.

hook.text: When temperature rises 10 degrees, beer sales jump 15%. Regression finds that hidden relationship.

buildup.text: Regression analysis models demand as a function of external variables—price, weather, marketing spend.

discovery.text: It quantifies how much each factor moves demand, giving planners causal insight, not just pattern matching.

twist.text: Correlation isn't causation. Ice cream sales and drownings both rise in summer—but one doesn't cause the other.

climax.text: Regression works best when combined with domain knowledge to confirm that the drivers make business sense.

punchline.text: Find what drives demand. Then use it to predict.

quiz.question: What does regression analysis model demand as?
